input.summary: Make the licence transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position requires the licence to survive a corporate transaction, so we made it transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition and carved that transfer out of the Section 3(c) transfer restriction; affiliate coverage in the grant is already acceptable.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing, provided that Sparkling may transfer the licence granted under Section 2 to a successor in a merger or acquisition without Garman's approval;
